risks: A missing ffmpeg or libass is a FAIL because both are required, so environments without them will not pass cleanly.
An uncached, partial or ambiguous GPU model is SKIPPED, so a SKIP does not prove GPU transcription works.
Absent hardware or an uninstalled optional engine is SKIPPED, limiting what a single run proves.
